segments.text: Today I show you the London open fade on EURUSD.
Mark the Asian session high and low on the 15 minute chart.
When price breaks the Asian high in the first hour of London and closes back inside the range, sell at the next candle open.
Put the stop five pips above the breakout wick.
I usually take profit somewhere around the middle of the range, it depends.
